name: AFTERSCHOOL SPECIAL
source:
AFTERSCHOOL SPECIAL is a visual novel about a perfectly normal and well-adjusted teenager named BENITO, with a perfectly normal friend named VISHAL, living a perfectly normal and well-adjusted life. through a camera, you play as him, or maybe you are simply holding the camera in place, as you tread through choices in this perfectly normal and well-adjusted friday.

[From [url=https://barrancaabajo.itch.io/afterschoolspecial]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《AFTERSCHOOL SPECIAL》是一部视觉小说，讲述了一名再正常不过、身心无比健康的少年贝尼托，和他再正常不过的好友维沙尔一起过着再正常不过、身心无比健康的生活。透过一台摄像机的镜头，你将扮演他——又或者你只是单纯举着摄像机定格画面——在这个再正常不过、身心无比健康的星期五里，一步步走过接踵而至的选择。

[摘自[url=https://barrancaabajo.itch.io/afterschoolspecial]itch.io[/url]]
